morena-iluminada-caramelo: Caramel highlights on a natural dark brown base, level 4-5, kept intact at the roots. Fine to medium woven highlights in a warm golden-amber caramel, level 7, start a couple of centimeters below the roots and run through the mid-lengths and ends, densest on the top layer and face-framing pieces and slightly brighter toward the ends. Softly blended with no stripes or harsh lines, multi-tonal brown and caramel strands, never orange, glossy realistic salon result.
mechas-loiras-tradicionais: Classic foil highlights in a light neutral beige blonde, level 9-10, placed as evenly spaced medium-width strands starting right at the roots and running all the way to the ends over the whole head. The natural medium brown base, level 5-6, stays visible between them, giving a clear, defined contrast of blonde and brown strands. Toned to remove yellow, crisp but natural-looking strands, uniform distribution, healthy shine and a realistic professional bleach-and-tone result.
balayage-loiro: Blonde balayage: a deep brunette base, level 4-5, stays natural at the roots, while hand-painted ribbons of light beige-golden blonde, level 9, sweep down from around the mid-lengths and become brighter and fuller toward the ends. The brightest pieces sit in the face-framing sections and the underside stays darker for depth. Soft, seamless, diffused transition with no visible start lines, irregular sun-kissed placement, toned clean without brassiness, multi-dimensional strands and luminous shine.
mechas-air-touch: Air touch blonde: a soft natural light brown root, level 6, blurs gradually into a bright creamy beige-pearl blonde, level 10, through the mid-lengths and ends. The lightened strands are extremely fine and numerous, perfectly diffused, with no stripes, no foil lines and no harsh demarcation, so the hair reads as mostly blonde with an airy, smudged root-to-end transition. Toned neutral-cool without yellow, with natural strand-by-strand variation and silky reflective shine.
babylights-loiro: Soft blonde babylights: micro-fine, delicate highlights in a light beige-golden blonde, level 8-9, woven densely from the roots to the ends over a natural light-to-medium brown base, level 6. Each highlight is thinner than a pencil line, so the color reads as a subtle, diffused, sun-kissed glow rather than visible stripes, slightly concentrated along the part line and the face-framing pieces. Low contrast, seamless blend, natural strand-by-strand variation and healthy shine.
morena-iluminada-mel: Honey highlights on a natural medium-to-dark brown base, level 5, kept at the roots. Fine woven highlights in a warm golden honey, level 8, start a few centimeters from the roots and spread through the mid-lengths and ends, concentrated on the face-framing pieces and top layer. Softly blended for a sunny, glowing, multi-tonal brown with golden reflections, never orange or brassy. Natural strand variation and a glossy, healthy shine.
luzes-finas-douradas: Fine golden highlights: many thin, closely spaced highlights in a warm golden blonde, level 8-9, distributed evenly over the whole head from the roots to the ends, over a natural light brown base, level 6. The fine strands blend into an overall brighter, warm golden look with a delicate weave of gold and brown, more luminous on the top layer. Soft, neat, natural-looking strands with no chunky sections, realistic dye result and a glossy finish.
contorno-iluminado: Face-framing highlight contour: the front hairline sections on both sides of the part, plus a little of the top layer near the part, lightened to a soft warm honey-caramel blonde, level 8, starting close to the roots and blending smoothly into the rest of the hair. All other hair keeps a natural brown base, level 5, with only a few sparse fine highlights behind. Soft, diffused, blended edges rather than crisp blocks, golden luminous tone and natural shine.
balayage-caramelo: Caramel balayage: a rich dark brown base, level 4, kept natural at the roots, with hand-painted sweeps of warm golden-amber caramel, level 7, starting below the roots around the mid-lengths and melting into a lighter golden caramel at the ends. Wider, brighter ribbons in the face-framing pieces, with darker brown strands left between for depth. Seamless, soft, diffused gradient, warm but never orange, multi-tonal strands and a glossy finish.
mechas-platinadas: Platinum highlights: defined medium-fine strands lifted to platinum blonde, level 10-11, toned cool silvery-white with no yellow, placed from the roots to the ends evenly over the whole head on a natural dark brown base, level 4-5. Strong, high-contrast pattern of icy white strands alternating with deep brown, more concentrated on the top layer and the face-framing pieces. Clean, bright, crisp highlights with a realistic professional bleach-and-tone result and healthy shine.
ombre-hair-classico: Classic ombré: natural dark brown, level 4, from the roots through the upper part of the hair, gradually fading horizontally into a light golden-beige blonde, level 9, at the ends. The transition starts around the mid-lengths and is smooth and progressive, with a warm caramel middle zone and the lightest blonde on the last section of the ends. Even all around the head, gentle gradient with no harsh line, toned without brassiness, glossy finish.
money-piece: Money piece: two bold, bright creamy beige blonde panels, level 10, at the very front hairline sections on both sides of the part, lightened from the roots all the way to the ends. The rest of the hair stays its natural medium-to-dark brown, level 4-5. High-contrast, clean blonde front sections with slightly softened edges blending into the brown behind them, toned free of yellow, with glossy shine and a realistic professional bleach-and-tone result.
morena-iluminada-loiro-bege: Beige blonde highlights on a natural dark brown base, level 4-5, kept at the roots. Plenty of fine to medium highlights in a light neutral beige blonde, level 9, start about two fingers from the roots and spread through the mid-lengths and ends, so the hair still reads as brunette but strongly brightened, especially in the face-framing pieces. Toned beige without yellow, well-blended strands with clear but elegant contrast, glossy finish.
balayage-mel: Honey balayage: a medium brown base, level 5, kept natural at the roots, with hand-painted ribbons of warm amber-gold honey blonde, level 8, starting at the mid-lengths and getting brighter and more saturated toward the ends. Brighter honey pieces in the face-framing sections and top layer, deeper brown left underneath. Soft, seamless sun-kissed melt with no visible lines, warm golden glow that is never brassy, luminous multi-tonal shine.
mechas-californianas: Californian highlights: a natural brown root, level 5, kept dark at the top, then sun-kissed highlights in a warm golden blonde, level 8-9, starting around ear height and growing progressively denser and lighter toward the ends, which look almost fully blonde. Soft visible strands of golden blonde mixed with brown create a natural, sun-bleached, beachy gradient. Warm sunny gold, never orange, blended and luminous with a healthy shine.
raiz-esfumada: Light cool beige blonde, level 10, from the mid-lengths to the ends, with a soft smudged root shadow in a darker ash brown, level 6, covering the first few centimeters from the scalp. The shadow fades gently downward into the blonde with a blurred, diffused edge and no hard regrowth line, adding lived-in depth at the top. Blonde lengths toned clean without yellow, fine multi-tonal strands and glossy shine.
morena-iluminada-avela: Hazelnut highlights on a natural dark brown base, level 4: subtle, soft highlights only two shades lighter in a neutral golden-brown hazelnut, level 6, woven finely through the mid-lengths and ends and the face-framing pieces. Very low contrast, so the hair stays brunette but gains dimension, movement and warm glints of light. Natural, discreet, seamless blend with rich glossy shine.
balayage-acinzentado: Ash balayage: a dark ash brown base, level 4-5, kept natural at the roots, with hand-painted ribbons lifted and toned to a cool smoky ash blonde to soft silver, level 8-9, with silvery-gray reflections, flowing from the mid-lengths and brightest at the ends, with the face-framing sections a touch lighter. Cool and smoky, completely free of gold, warmth or orange, with a soft seamless melt between the cool brown and the ash blonde and a satin shine.
babylights-perolado: Pearl babylights: micro-fine highlights in a very light pearl blonde, level 10, with a soft iridescent violet-beige tone, woven densely from the roots to the ends over a natural light brown base, level 6-7. The tiny strands create a delicate, shimmering, luminous veil, brighter on the top layer and the face-framing pieces, with no visible stripes. Cool-neutral pearly reflections, no yellow, seamless blend and silky shine.
color-melting: Color melting: three tones blended seamlessly from roots to ends with no visible lines or sections. Deep chocolate brown, level 4, at the roots melts into a warm caramel brown, level 6, through the mid-lengths and then into a golden honey blonde, level 8, at the ends. Each shade dissolves softly into the next like a watercolor gradient, with fine multi-tonal strands at every transition. Warm, rich, luminous and very glossy.
balayage-perolado: Pearl balayage: a medium ash brown base, level 5-6, kept soft at the roots, with hand-painted ribbons lifted to a very light pearl blonde, level 10, toned with iridescent violet-beige reflections, starting at the mid-lengths and brightest at the ends and face-framing pieces. Seamless diffused melt, cool-neutral glow with a soft lilac-silver shimmer, completely free of yellow. Multi-tonal strands and a satiny, mother-of-pearl shine.
mechas-ruivas: Copper-red highlights: medium-fine strands in a vivid, saturated red-copper, level 7, woven from close to the roots to the ends over a natural medium-to-dark brown base, level 4-5. The copper strands are evenly distributed and slightly denser on the top layer and face-framing pieces, creating a fiery contrast of red and brown. Rich, vibrant, realistic dye result with natural variation between strands and a glossy shine.
balayage-cobre: Copper balayage: a natural dark brown base, level 4-5, at the roots, with hand-painted ribbons of bright orange-copper with golden reflections, level 7-8, sweeping from the mid-lengths and becoming most vivid and luminous at the ends, with the face-framing pieces slightly brighter. Soft, seamless melt from brown to copper, with deeper brown strands left between for dimension. Rich saturated copper, realistic dye result and glossy shine.
root-melt: Root melt into blonde: a soft natural medium brown, level 5-6, at the roots blends downward in a slow, gradual melt through a light bronde transition into a warm golden-beige blonde, level 9, from the mid-lengths to the ends. There is no visible line or regrowth band; the root color slowly dissolves into the blonde with fine blended strands, creating a lived-in, low-maintenance look. Luminous blonde lengths toned without yellow, glossy finish.
mechas-canela: Cinnamon highlights: soft, fine highlights in a warm cinnamon, a light copper-brown at level 6-7 with spicy golden-copper reflections, woven through the mid-lengths and ends and the face-framing pieces over a natural dark brown base, level 4. Low to medium contrast, so the hair stays brunette with a warm, spiced, coppery glow and movement. Seamlessly blended, never orange, with natural strand variation and a rich glossy finish.
balayage-chocolate: Chocolate balayage: a deep natural black-brown base, level 2-3, with hand-painted ribbons of warm milk chocolate brown, level 5-6, sweeping from the mid-lengths and lightest at the ends and face-framing pieces. Subtle, elegant contrast that keeps the hair dark while adding soft brown dimension and movement. Seamless diffused blend, rich cocoa tone with no red or orange, natural strand variation and an intense glossy shine.
sombre: Soft ombré: natural medium brown, level 5, at the roots fading very gradually into a light golden-beige brown to dark blonde, level 7, at the ends, only two shades lighter. The transition is gradual, subtle and seamless, beginning near the mid-lengths, with a few soft lighter strands blending into the brown so no horizontal line shows. Natural, sun-faded, discreet look with fine strand variation and a luminous, glossy finish.
reflexo-acobreado: Copper reflect gloss: the current base color keeps the same depth, with a sheer, translucent copper glaze over the whole head from roots to ends that adds warm copper-gold reflections, visible mostly where light hits the hair. Shadowed areas stay deep while the light-catching strands glow with a soft copper-amber sheen. A subtle, even, transparent tint rather than a full red, with a high-gloss, healthy, mirror-like shine.
balayage-rose-gold: Rose gold balayage: a medium brown base, level 5-6, soft at the roots, with hand-painted ribbons of rose gold, a light level 8-9 blonde toned with a delicate pinkish-peach copper reflection and metallic glow, flowing from the mid-lengths and brightest at the ends and face-framing pieces. Seamless, diffused melt from brown to rosy gold, soft and romantic, never vivid pink. Multi-tonal strands and luminous satin shine.
lowlights-caramelo: Caramel lowlights in blonde: a light golden-beige blonde base, level 9, with fine to medium strands of a deeper warm caramel brown, level 6-7, woven from the roots to the ends over the whole head. The darker strands add depth, contrast and dimension, especially in the underneath and inner layers, while the top stays bright. A balanced weave of blonde and caramel, naturally blended, warm and luminous, with glossy shine.
ombre-ruivo: Red ombré: natural dark brown, level 4, at the roots and upper hair fading gradually into a warm copper red, level 6-7, through the mid-lengths and a bright, vibrant copper-orange red, level 7-8, at the ends. Smooth, progressive gradient with no hard line, deeper auburn in the transition zone and the most saturated, luminous copper at the very ends. Rich, realistic dye result with natural strand variation and a glossy finish.
mechas-fantasia-rosa: Hot bubblegum pink fantasy highlights: medium-width strands pre-lightened and colored a vivid, saturated pink, placed from the roots to the ends throughout the hair and more concentrated on the top layer and face-framing pieces. The current base color stays unchanged between the pink strands. Bold, playful contrast, clean even pink with slight variation from fuchsia to softer pink between strands, realistic semi-permanent fashion-color result with glossy shine.
foilyage-loiro: Foilyage blonde: a balayage placement lifted in foils for maximum brightness, in a creamy bright blonde, level 10, with a clean neutral-beige tone, starting a little below the roots and becoming fuller and brighter through the mid-lengths and ends. The natural medium brown root, level 5, stays soft at the top. Bold, high-contrast, very luminous blonde ribbons, brightest in the face-framing pieces, seamlessly blended near the roots, toned without yellow, glossy shine.
teasylights: Buttery blonde teasylights: backcombed highlights that give an ultra-diffused, lived-in blonde in a warm creamy butter tone, level 9, with soft golden-beige reflections. The natural light brown, level 6, at the roots blurs softly into the blonde with no visible lines or stripes, and the blonde becomes fuller through the mid-lengths and ends. Soft-focus, airy, seamless blend, multi-tonal buttery strands and luminous shine.
mechas-ocultas: Peekaboo hidden highlights: the top layer of the hair keeps its current color unchanged, while the underneath layer at the nape and behind the ears is lightened to a bright platinum blonde, level 10, from the roots to the ends. The platinum sections peek out only from beneath the top layer and where the lower hair shows, creating a concealed contrast panel. Crisp, clean, icy-toned blonde with no yellow and a glossy finish.
tiger-eye: Tigerseye: a deep rich chocolate brown base, level 3-4, with warm ribbons of amber-caramel and golden honey, level 6-7, swirled through the mid-lengths and ends like the glints of a polished tigerseye gemstone. The amber tones gather toward the ends and face-framing pieces, softly blended into the dark brown with no harsh lines, giving a glowing, multi-dimensional dark-and-gold effect. Rich and warm, never brassy, with a glossy finish.
chunky-highlights: Y2K chunky highlights: thick, bold stripes about two centimeters wide, lifted to a bright golden-platinum blonde, level 10, running from the roots to the ends and alternating clearly with wide sections of natural dark brown, level 3-4. Strong, crisp, high-contrast striped pattern, most visible on the top layer and the two front face-framing sections, with defined edges in the early-2000s style. Clean saturated blonde and a glossy finish.
ombre-reverso: Reverse ombré: a light golden-beige blonde, level 9, at the roots and upper hair, gradually darkening downward through a warm caramel brown, level 6, at the mid-lengths into a deep chocolate brown, level 4, at the ends. Smooth, seamless gradient with no hard line, light on top and dark at the bottom, even all around the head, with natural strand variation and a rich, glossy finish.
ombre-fantasia-roxo: Purple fantasy ombré: natural dark brown, level 3-4, at the roots and upper hair fading gradually into a deep, vivid violet-purple through the mid-lengths and a bright pastel lavender-lilac at the very ends. Smooth, progressive gradient with no hard line, saturated violet tones that grow lighter and more pastel toward the ends. Rich, vibrant, realistic fashion-color result with natural variation between strands and a glossy shine.
mechas-fantasia-azul: Electric cobalt blue fantasy highlights: medium-width strands pre-lightened and colored a vivid, saturated blue, varying slightly from deep royal blue to brighter blue between strands, placed from the roots to the ends throughout the hair and more concentrated on the top layer and face-framing pieces. The current base color stays unchanged between them. Bold, playful contrast, clean even blue, realistic fashion-color dye result with glossy shine.
split-dye-preto-loiro: Split dye: the hair is colored in two contrasting halves divided vertically along the part line, front to back: one side a deep, glossy jet black, level 1, and the other side a bright, almost-white platinum blonde, level 10, both from the roots to the ends. The dividing line follows the part cleanly and each side is completely even and saturated. Bold, graphic contrast, platinum toned clean without yellow, with a glossy finish.
dip-dye-vermelho: Vivid cherry red dip dye: only the bottom third of the hair is colored a saturated crimson red with bright scarlet reflections, ending in a deliberately crisp, defined horizontal line where the color starts. Everything above the dyed ends keeps its current color unchanged. Bold two-tone contrast, even and fully saturated red through the ends, realistic fashion-color dye result with natural strand variation and glossy shine.
underlights-arco-iris: Hidden rainbow underlights: the top layer of the hair keeps its current color unchanged, while the underneath layer at the nape and lower sides is colored in vertical bands of vivid rainbow shades, red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet, from the roots to the ends. The rainbow peeks out from beneath the top layer wherever the lower hair shows. Saturated, clean fashion colors with soft blending between the bands and a glossy shine.
